title: #forge-eng: Sprint 14 kickoff — navigation and offline sprint

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Sprint 14 kickoff. Key goals: (1) Tab bar navigation (FORGE-30) — this is the structural foundation for deep links and must land early. (2) iOS widget (FORGE-31). (3) Offline mode (FORGE-32) — biggest story. Also clearing bug backlog: iOS 16 crash (FORGE-28) and camera memory leak (FORGE-29).

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: I'll drive tab bar (FORGE-30) and offline mode (FORGE-32). Tab bar needs to finalize first — deep links (FORGE-36) can't start until the navigation structure is locked. I'll also pick up haptics (FORGE-33) as a quick win.

title: #forge-eng: iOS 16 rotation crash — regression from grid refactor

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Found a regression from last sprint's grid layout refactor: crash on device rotation in task view, iOS 16 only. FORGE-28. Root cause: UICollectionViewLayout invalidation calls reloadData before the layout has committed — iOS 17+ handles this gracefully but 16 doesn't. Working on a fix.

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Good catch — this would block our iOS 16 users entirely. How long to fix?

title: #forge-eng: Tab bar vs gesture nav — architecture decision

messages.author: carlos-mendez
messages.text: Quick architecture note: I'm implementing UITabBarController for FORGE-30 per the sprint planning decision. There was a brief discussion about gesture-based navigation as an alternative but we agreed tab bar is the right default for discoverability. Starting implementation this week.

messages.author: mei-tanaka
messages.text: Agreed. Tab bar is the right call for our user base. Let's keep gesture nav as a future enhancement if analytics show power users want it. Deep links (FORGE-36) can't start until this is done.
